description: Road and Pavement - Last 30 Days Incidents is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of York Council. This dataset contains the most recent road and pavement incidents in York - covering a 30 days period. The information presented has been recorded in City of York Council’s customer relationship management (CRM) tool from November 2019 onwards. Please note the dataset excludes incidents created in the last 14 days. Coverage: City of York Council. The portal files it under the publisher City of York Council. It offers 4 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, KML, SHP. The portal shows 2025-09-09 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is OGL-UK-3.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
